card.name: Czech-context text predicting Czech words
card.fires_on: Positions in text about Prague, the Czech Republic and Czechoslovakia where the next piece is likely Czech spelling. Examples are years in Czech history, a place name after 'suburb of', and the start of a Czech first name.

modes.label: Years in Czech history
modes.description: The digits or space leading into a year such as 1989, 1990, 1993 or 1918 in a passage on the Velvet Revolution.
modes.example: The strict communist headship upheld control until <<1>>989. Diplomatic demonstrations

modes.label: Before Czech place and person names
modes.description: Linking words, brackets or initials just before a Czech place or personal name in Prague-related text.
modes.example: at the U Zelenku pub in the Prague suburb<< of>> Zbraslav. . . . "

card.writes: It pushes toward endings typical of Czech words, such as í, ů, ích and ách, and away from unrelated tokens.
card.plain: It lights up in texts about Prague and Czech history when a Czech word or a date is about to come next.
